title: Anticoncentration under hypercontractivity
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ have positive uniform $L^2$ norm $M$. Suppose $0<\rho<1$ and, for every $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the uniform $L^4$ norm of $a+\rho bX$ is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $a+bX$. Then for every $\theta\in\mathbb R$ and every $0<t<1$,
\[
\left(\frac{\rho^2(1-t^2)+\rho^2(\theta/M)^2}{1+\rho^2(\theta/M)^2}\right)^2
\leq \mathbb P_{x\text{ uniform on }\Omega}\!\left(tM<|X(x)-\theta|\right).
\]
